aspect-ratio.title: AspectRatio
aspect-ratio.explanation: Original AspectRatio wrapper. The illustration is application-authored content.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.explanation: Original Avatar, AvatarImage and AvatarFallback. Image loading and fallback are handled by the upstream primitive.

breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumbs.explanation: Original Breadcrumb composition. The plural Destyler family maps to the singular upstream component.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.explanation: Original Calendar surface backed by React Day Picker, with day selection and month/year dropdowns. This narrower reference does not reproduce Destyler Calendar’s input/popover, presets or separate month/year grid views.

carousel.title: Carousel
carousel.explanation: Original Carousel backed by Embla, using the same five illustrations and previous/next controls. This reference does not add the separate autoplay plugin or Destyler indicator/autoplay controls.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.explanation: Original Radix-backed Checkbox, initially unchecked, with the same Checkbox label.

clipboard.title: Clipboard composition
clipboard.explanation: Application-authored copy action using the original shadcn Button and the browser Clipboard API. There is no upstream Clipboard primitive; secure-context permissions and feedback are handled by this demo, not by shadcn.

collapse.title: Accordion
collapse.explanation: Original Accordion is the disclosure-list counterpart to Destyler Collapse. Names and APIs differ; this is not the same primitive as Collapsible.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.explanation: Original Collapsible with a separate trigger and expandable content.

color-picker.title: Color Picker
color-picker.explanation: No ColorPicker component exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. A color input would not be equivalent to Destyler color spaces, channels, swatches and picker interaction.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.explanation: This revision includes an original Base UI Combobox. The demo uses its exported Trigger with an explicit accessible name and a labeled original Button for clearing, rather than the unnamed convenience icons. It is not a native select or Popover/Command imitation.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.explanation: Original Dialog with Radix portal, overlay, title, description and explicit cancel action.

dynamic.title: Dynamic
dynamic.explanation: No dynamic/tag-input primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Combobox chips are selection UI, not an equivalent free-form dynamic-input state machine.

edit.title: Edit
edit.explanation: No inline-edit primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Input plus buttons would require application-authored commit, cancel and focus behavior.

field.title: Field
field.explanation: Original Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription and FieldError. Validation state is application-authored; no claim of identical Destyler validation behavior.

fieldset.title: FieldSet
fieldset.explanation: Original FieldSet and FieldLegend exported by field.tsx, with the same legend/help/error copy and a labeled Input. Validation is application state, not an equivalent Destyler fieldset state machine.

file-upload.title: File Upload
file-upload.explanation: No FileUpload primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Input type=file would not provide equivalent dropzone, file-list, validation or removal behavior.

floating-panel.title: Floating Panel
floating-panel.explanation: No FloatingPanel primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Popover and Dialog do not provide an equivalent draggable/resizable panel lifecycle.

hover-card.title: HoverCard
hover-card.explanation: Original HoverCard with trigger and portalled content. Pointer timing and focus behavior require real-browser verification.

label.title: Label
label.explanation: Original Label linked to the original Input by htmlFor and id.

menu.title: DropdownMenu
menu.explanation: Original DropdownMenu with checkbox, radio items and a submenu. This reference does not include the distinct ContextMenu trigger shown by the Destyler menu example.

navigation-menu.title: NavigationMenu
navigation-menu.explanation: Original NavigationMenu with link content and viewport. Links stay within this demo.

number-input.title: Number Input
number-input.explanation: No NumberInput primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. A native numeric Input would not be equivalent to Destyler stepping, formatting and interaction behavior.

otp-input.title: InputOTP
otp-input.explanation: Original InputOTP with grouped slots. This is an OTP input example, not authentication or code verification.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.explanation: Original Pagination link composition. Current-page state is application-authored; no data fetching is performed.

popover.title: Popover
popover.explanation: Original Popover with a trigger and a portalled content panel.

presence.title: Presence
presence.explanation: No standalone Presence primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Internal animation/mount behavior is not a public counterpart to Destyler Presence.

progress.title: Progress
progress.explanation: Original linear Progress starts at 65%; the demo supplies the visual percentage and explicit ARIA value. The pinned wrapper does not forward value to Radix, so its internal data-state remains indeterminate. No circular indicator or full behavioral equivalence is claimed.

qr-code.title: Qr Code
qr-code.explanation: No QRCode component exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. An image or placeholder would not demonstrate equivalent QR generation.

radio.title: RadioGroup
radio.explanation: Original RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem. The Destyler Radio family maps to the upstream RadioGroup.

scroll-area.title: ScrollArea
scroll-area.explanation: Original ScrollArea and ScrollBar. Actual overflow geometry, wheel and touch behavior require real-browser verification.

select.title: Select
select.explanation: Original Radix-backed Select with the same four frameworks and disabled Svelte. It has no separate clear trigger in this demo; this is not a native select imitation.

separator.title: Separator
separator.explanation: Original Separator in both horizontal and vertical orientations.

signature.title: Signature
signature.explanation: No Signature primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. A canvas alone would not demonstrate equivalent drawing, clearing and export behavior.

slider.title: Slider
slider.explanation: Original Slider with an application-controlled range. Pointer geometry requires real-browser verification.

splitter.title: Resizable
splitter.explanation: Original ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel and ResizableHandle, backed by react-resizable-panels v4. This is the splitter counterpart with a different API.

steps.title: Steps
steps.explanation: No Steps/Stepper primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Tabs or numbered buttons would not be an equivalent workflow state machine.

switch.title: Switch
switch.explanation: Original Radix-backed Switch, initially unchecked, with the same Label copy.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.explanation: Original Radix-backed Tabs with React, Solid, Vue and disabled Svelte, initially showing React.

timer.title: Timer
timer.explanation: No Timer primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. A custom interval would be application logic, not original shadcn UI.

toast.title: Sonner
toast.explanation: Original shadcn Toaster wrapper around Sonner. The upstream toast counterpart is Sonner, not a hand-built notification div.

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.explanation: Original Toggle with pressed and unpressed states.

toggle-group.title: ToggleGroup
toggle-group.explanation: Original ToggleGroup and ToggleGroupItem with single-selection behavior.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.explanation: Original TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger and TooltipContent. Pointer/focus timing and assistive technology remain browser checks.

tour.title: Tour
tour.explanation: No Tour primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Popover or Dialog alone would not provide equivalent target tracking and multi-step tour behavior.

tree.title: Tree
tree.explanation: No Tree primitive exists in the pinned upstream UI directory. Nested Collapsible panels would not supply an equivalent tree selection, navigation and keyboard model.
